title: Figure code and figures for: Five years of ICESat-2 supraglacial lake depths improve Greenland meltwater volume estimates

creators.name: Arndt, Philipp S.
creators.affiliation: Scripps Institution of Oceanography, University of California San Diego; Global Fishing Watch

creators.name: Fricker, Helen A.
creators.affiliation: Scripps Institution of Oceanography, University of California San Diego

description:
Related publication. Arndt PS and Fricker HA, “Five Years of ICESat-2 Supraglacial Lake Depths Improve Greenland Meltwater Volume Estimates”, submitted to Annals of Glaciology, 2026. This record will be updated with the full citation and DOI once the paper is available.

Notebooks, plotting code and input data that produce every figure in the accompanying paper, together with the rendered figures themselves.

One notebook per figure (fig02–fig06, figS01-S03) over a shared plotting module (figscode.py), plus the figure inputs that are not available elsewhere: the merged IMBIE drainage basins extended with adjacent floating ice tongues, elevation contours derived from ArcticDEM, ICESat-2 reference ground tracks, the per-segment HDF5 files used as examples, the sonar validation data, and the Sentinel-2 chips behind the methods explainer.

Third-party inputs are not redistributed here and are cited in the paper instead: ArcticDEM mosaics (PGC), the original IMBIE drainage basins, the GIMP ice mask (NSIDC), ICESat-2 ATL03 (NSIDC), Sentinel-2 (Copernicus), and the in situ sonar depths (PANGAEA).
